answers.statement: Drive Parry is active from frame 1 and becomes a Perfect Parry if it catches an attack on its first 2 frames; throws beat it on every active and recovery frame as an inescapable Punish Counter. Recovery is given as 33 frames in the SuperCombo table and bullet and in Capcom's table, but one SuperCombo line still calls the standard recovery 29f.
